questions.question: You have led data integration and ETL efforts across several organizations. Walk me through a complex ETL pipeline you designed or improved, including the source systems, transformation logic, data-quality controls, and how you measured success.

In your work on the WEDS logical data architecture, you supported master, transaction, structured, unstructured, and document data. How did you model the relationships and establish standards that allowed these data types to be used consistently?
Describe the ETL proof of concept where you linked IDs from different systems into a universal ID. What matching approach, survivorship rules, and exception handling did you use?

This role requires expert Spark and ScalaSpark experience. What Spark workloads have you personally built or operated, and how have you addressed issues such as skew, partitioning, joins, memory pressure, or slow-running jobs?

What experience do you have developing production software with Java and Spring, particularly REST APIs? Please describe an API you designed, its data-access approach, and how it was deployed and maintained.

You have written custom functions and stored procedures for cleansing and transforming data. Describe an example where database-side processing was the right choice versus performing the transformation in an ETL application or distributed processing framework.

At Armed Forces Services Corporation, you helped move key infrastructure services to cloud infrastructure. What services were moved, what cloud architecture decisions did you make, and how did you handle security, reliability, and migration risk?

When refactoring the Natural application and moving data from ADAbase to SQL Server, how did you validate migration completeness, preserve data integrity, and reconcile differences between the source and target data models?
Describe a time you identified and resolved a database or data-pipeline performance problem. How did you diagnose the issue, what changes did you implement, and what was the outcome?

You have led teams, conducted peer reviews, and mentored junior developers. How do you set technical standards for data engineering work and help engineers improve the quality and maintainability of their solutions?
